findings.one_line: The advertised finite-sample graph-set deliverable is still only the existential union \(\mathcal D_n=\bigcup_{t\in C_n}\mathcal D(t)\); lift the fixed-DAG finite feasibility/evaluation procedure from the open-question discussion into this definition or thm:outer-fiber-confidence, since the theorem otherwise gives readers no stated computable outward-inversion map.
